scripts.build: wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv cloudflare-env.d.ts >/dev/null && next build
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy

DB.description: D1 database for accounts, tokens and documents. A new one is created for you, and migrations run on every deploy.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for the images and videos agents upload into reports. R2 must be turned on for your account first (free up to 10 GB, but it asks for a payment method).
